mech: 解約率・更新率の実数
why: 「churn ... 1% to 2%」の実数と「repositioning a site ... may be expensive」＝顧客側の移設費用。再認定は無し
「leverage their qualification efforts onto successive product models」は顧客の負担が減る便益で乗り換え費用に触れない
「place instrumentation with customers」＋消耗品で「recover the cost」＝据えた装置の上に売上が乗る設置基盤
「recertification of parts obtained from new suppliers」＝当社が仕入先を替える話で負うのは当社。「may」で断定でもない
「we must usually obtain and maintain certifications」＝当社が受ける認証で向きが逆。顧客側の再認定ではない
「ability to achieve qualification for ... OEM systems」＝当社が認定を取りに行く側の願望形。顧客の費用に触れない
「five or more years」の期間はあるが、同じ文が「consider other providers」と乗り換えの機会を明示している
「Once designed into a new aircraft, the spare parts business is frequently retained」＝設計組込による固着の断定
「will be sourced virtually all ... through 2015」＝期間を区切った全量調達の断定。乗り換え費用の記述は無い
「Our depth of expertise」を基礎とする「sole source provider」「over 70%」は地位の自慢と実績で機構が無い
「designed in by leading semiconductor companies and OEMs」は採用先の列挙のみで固着の帰結も費用も無い
「moving a Site Set home ... involves substantial cost and effort」＝移設費用の断定。負う者は明示されない
「We have sought to」の願望形。「cannot be easily or quickly replaced」は主張のみで機構の名指しが無い
「required by the customer's specifications or designs」「necessitating reliance on us」＝顧客の設計への組込の断定
「non-cancellable for 10 to 20 years」「non-cancellable for 10 years or longer」＝解約不能の複数年契約の断定
「customers typically do not relocate」「low tenant lease terminations」＝物理的固着。解約率の実数は無い
「high conversion costs can create barriers to adoption」＝移行費用の名指し。ただし「can」で断定でない
「one to thirteen years」の期間はあるが「can provide ... conversion support」＝当社が支援を負う側
「built a facility on land owned by the customer」＝物理的固着。明示の費用は「obligated to remove」＝当社
「new competitors face significant barriers to entry」「certification requirements」＝参入障壁で顧客の移行費用ではない
「customers must generate」大量のデータゆえ「difficult to change ... one supplier with ... another」＝顧客が再検証を負う断定
「our strategy is to market ... to work with us」＝戦略の願望形で摩擦の機構の名指しが無い
「contract extension of up to nine years」は延長の事実のみ。「up to」で確定せず機構も無い
「must integrate with ... systems of our customers」「time-consuming and expensive」を負うのは当社側
「It generally takes us up to 12 months」「must be designed into our customers' products」＝当社が組み込まれに行く負担
「on the part of that manufacturer」の費用は顧客側だが「difficult for us to achieve future design wins」＝当社が外側
